title: Top Aluminium Truss Manufacturers in India (2026): List With Contacts
excerpt: Six verified aluminium truss manufacturers in India for stage, lighting and exhibition truss, with contacts, certifications and a buyer's checklist.
content:
India's aluminium truss market is a handful of specialist makers plus a long tail of scaffolding firms and traders that also sell truss. After checking each company's own website on 4 October 2026, we shortlisted six manufacturers worth calling for stage, lighting and exhibition truss. Each entry gives its city, what it makes, any certification it claims and an official business contact. Before you place an order, ask any of them for load-span tables and alloy certificates.

Key takeaways

  • Only a few Indian makers publish engineering data online. Tiger Truss and TBA Truss list alloy grades, tube sizes, spans or certifications. Most others list only product names.
  • India has no truss-specific BIS standard. Serious makers cite ANSI E1.2-2021, EN 17115:2018 or EN 1090 instead, so ask to see the documents.
  • Several "manufacturers" are registered on IndiaMART as traders, or share phone numbers with sister firms. We flag this where we saw it.
  • Treat a load-span table as the minimum. A seller who can't give you one for the exact truss and span you're buying is a red flag.

How we built this list

We started from the names that appear most often on B2B directories and in search results. Then we opened each company's own website and checked four things: that the site works, that it describes truss it makes rather than resells, that it publishes a business contact, and whether it offers anything verifiable, such as a GST number, a certification, published specifications or news coverage. Entries are ranked on how much engineering data a buyer can check before calling: certification claims, alloy and tube specifications, published spans or load charts, and an independent track record. Truss specialists rank above scaffolding firms that sell truss as a side line.

No company paid to be listed. Inclusion is not an endorsement; verify before you order. Certifications below are what each company claims on its own site, and we have not seen the certificates. We print phone numbers only when they're company lines (landlines or the business numbers IndiaMART assigns to sellers). Where a firm publishes only mobile numbers, we link to its contact page instead.

The manufacturers

1. Tiger Truss (Candescent Lighting), Pune

Tiger Truss is a Pune brand that its About page says is owned and marketed by Candescent Lighting. The range covers square, triangle and circular truss, tower lifting systems, roof systems, stages and truss tents. The company says its products are calculated to Eurocode and meet TÜV safety requirements, and that it runs a training programme for users. Its square-truss line, Safe Span, comes in sizes from SS-30 to SS-52 with 3 mm main-tube walls. The product page quotes spans of 12 to 19 m and pitches the truss at rental, touring and exhibition companies. Ask for the load table that matches your span before you rely on those figures.

Contact: info@tigertruss.com. Its contact page lists two locations on Sus Road, Pune.

2. TBA Truss, Faridabad

TBA Truss, based in Faridabad, says it was founded in 2014, according to its About page. The product catalogue is unusually specific for an Indian maker. Every series uses EN AW-6082-T6 main tubes, from 50×3 mm on the 290 mm Aero Truss to 50×4 or 60×4 mm on the heavier Ultra Tough and Titanium Beam lines. The site quotes free spans of up to 20 m (TB 6151), 24 m (TB 6151x), 36 m (TB 7752 and 7763) and 40 m (TB 8563). Powder-coat colours and a polished finish are optional. These are the maker's own figures, so ask for the load table and test basis behind each one.

Contact: info@tbatruss.com. The address is Railway Road, New Industrial Township, Faridabad (contact page).

3. Legend Truss / Crystal Aluminium Products, Hyderabad

Legend Truss sells aluminium goal-post truss, box truss and accessories. Its About page says it has been in business since 2009 and uses EN AW-6082-T6 alloy. The site lists the same phone numbers as Crystal Aluminium Products, a Moosapet, Hyderabad firm that makes scaffolding, ladders and truss. That suggests the two are run together. Crystal's IndiaMART-hosted site lists it as a manufacturer with 11 to 25 staff and shows its GST number. Legend Truss also runs pages aimed at Ahmedabad, Mumbai and Coimbatore. Its stated base is Hyderabad, so confirm where your order will be made.

Contact: info@legendtruss.in. Crystal's IndiaMART line is 080-4780-5706 (source).

4. Shiv Industries, Mumbai

Shiv Industries makes event, wedding, exhibition, round and goal-post truss, along with corner boxes, base plates and aluminium scaffolding. It also takes fabrication work, according to its IndiaMART-hosted site and its older site, miw.in. Its profile gives a registered address in MIDC Taloja, Navi Mumbai, with manufacturing listed as an additional business. The firm has a long track record in Mumbai's event trade, but its own pages give three different founding years (2005, 2009 and 2011), and many product listings show the same placeholder price. Use it for custom fabrication, and get drawings and alloy certificates in writing.

Contact: IndiaMART line 079-4931-2952 (source).

5. Access Engineering Products Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru

Access Engineering is the oldest company on this list. Its About page gives 1992 as the year it was established. It mainly makes aluminium ladders, scaffold and access towers, and modular stages, and it lists an aluminium truss for banquet, garden and wedding venues on its truss page. It's a better fit for venues and event companies that want truss, staging and access towers from one supplier than for touring-grade rigs. It publishes landline numbers and company emails, which is still rare in this trade.

Contact: sales@accessengg.com, +91-80-2348-2256 or +91-80-2348-7188. The office is on Magadi Road, Kamakshipalya, Bengaluru (contact page).

6. JPR Tig Welding Works, Chennai

JPR is a scaffolding and ladder maker in Ambattur, Chennai, that also makes rectangular, box, triangle and circular aluminium truss, according to its truss page. Its IndiaMART-hosted site claims ISO 9001:2015 certification and shows a GST number. Its profile says it was set up in 2017. A related firm, Sunjet Access Solution, sells lighting truss from Chennai, and its GST number carries the same PAN, which means the same proprietor. JPR's welding background helps with custom shapes. Insist on 6082-T6 tube certificates and a load table, because neither site publishes them.

Contact: IndiaMART line 080-4779-0234 (source).

Who we left out, and why

Several names that rank for "truss manufacturers" did not pass our checks. One domain we checked redirects to a parked page. An IndiaMART "manufacturer" in Coimbatore describes itself as a service provider, founded in 2022, with up to 10 staff. Other firms turned out to be lighting or sound rental companies, makers of decorative lamps, flight cases or interior profiles, or traders. A few genuine-looking Delhi, Ghaziabad, Indore and Navi Mumbai fabricators have no website of their own, only directory listings, so we couldn't check them against an official page. We'll add companies when they can be verified. If you make aluminium truss in India and can share your load tables and certificates, use the form below.

How to choose an aluminium truss manufacturer

Start with the job, not the catalogue

Write down the span, the total load and how that load is placed (spread evenly, a single point, or several points), whether the structure will be ground-supported or flown, and whether it will stand outdoors. Then ask each maker to quote the specific truss model that carries that load at that span with margin to spare. A wedding entrance arch, a 12 m lighting grid and an outdoor concert roof need very different truss.

Ask for the load-span table

International brands publish tables that list the allowable load for each span under different loading patterns. The Global Truss F34 table, for example, gives uniformly distributed, centre-point, third-point and quarter-point loads, and states the deflection limit (L/180) the figures are based on. An Indian maker should give you the same for the exact model you're buying, plus the basis of the calculation and who checked it.

Check the alloy and the welding

Most professional truss uses EN AW-6082-T6 aluminium tube. The F34 drawings, for instance, specify 6082-T6 for the main chords and diagonals. Ask for mill certificates for the tube, the wall thickness of the main chords (2, 3 or 4 mm makes a large difference), and how welds are qualified and inspected. On the makers' own pages, TBA Truss and Legend Truss name 6082-T6, and Tiger Truss gives its wall thickness.

Standards and certifications that matter

India has no BIS standard written specifically for entertainment truss, so buyers rely on international ones:

  • ANSI E1.2-2021 covers the design, manufacture and use of aluminium trusses and towers for entertainment. The standards body ESTA lists it among its published standards, dated May 2021.
  • EN 17115:2018 is the European specification for designing and manufacturing aluminium and steel entertainment truss. BSI lists the UK edition as current, published 30 September 2018.
  • EN 1090 governs how steel and aluminium structures are executed and assessed. Part 3 covers aluminium, and the standard sets four execution classes (EXC1 to EXC4) with stricter requirements at each level. Manufacturers need a third-party-certified factory production control system, according to Hilti.

A claim is not a certificate. Ask for the certificate itself, check that it names the factory you're buying from, and check that it's still valid. For anything flown over an audience or used outdoors, have a qualified structural engineer review the design and the load calculations. This article is general guidance, not engineering advice.

What drives the price

Truss is usually priced per metre or per piece, and the main cost drivers are visible in the makers' own specifications: section size (290 mm, 400 mm, 520 mm and larger), main-tube diameter and wall thickness, alloy grade, connector type (bolted plates, spigots or conical couplers), finish (mill, polished or powder-coated), and accessories such as corners, sleeve blocks and base plates. TBA Truss, for example, offers 50×3, 50×4 and 60×4 mm tubes across its range. Listed prices on directory sites are only a rough guide. Crystal Aluminium Products lists an exhibition-stand truss at about ₹2,400 per square foot, while some other listings show the same placeholder price on every product. Get written quotes for the same specification from at least three makers.

A note on steel roof truss: if you're building a shed, warehouse or factory roof, you need structural steel truss or a pre-engineered building, not event truss. That's a separate market with its own codes, and we'll cover it in a separate list.

Questions to ask before you sign

  • Which model and section size do you recommend for this span and load, and can I see its load-span table?
  • Is the tube 6082-T6, and will you supply mill certificates with the delivery?
  • Who does your structural calculations, and to which standard (ANSI E1.2, EN 17115, Eurocode)?
  • Do you make the truss in your own factory? What is that factory's address, and is it the one named on your certificates?
  • What is the warranty, and how do you handle damaged or deformed sections?
  • Can you match connectors with the truss we already own?

Red flags

  • No load-span table, or one copied from a foreign brand without your model name on it.
  • "Certified" claims with no certificate, or a certificate in another company's name.
  • A GST registration that doesn't match the trading name. You can check any GSTIN on the GST portal.
  • Different founding years, addresses or phone numbers across the company's own pages.
  • A price far below other quotes for the same section and wall thickness.

Trade shows are a good place to inspect truss in person. PALM Expo, India's pro audio and lighting show, covers rigging and trussing. Its organisers list the next edition for 27–29 May 2027 in Mumbai.

Bottom line

For touring and large outdoor work, start with makers that publish real specifications and certification claims: Tiger Truss and TBA Truss. Then verify the claims. For exhibitions, weddings and venue installs, the Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai firms can be practical choices, as long as you get load tables and alloy certificates in writing. FAQ

Which aluminium alloy is used for stage truss?

Professional truss usually uses EN AW-6082-T6 tube. Several Indian makers on this list, including TBA Truss and Legend Truss, name it on their websites. Ask for mill certificates rather than relying on the claim.

Is there a BIS standard for aluminium truss in India?

There is no truss-specific BIS standard. Buyers and makers usually refer to ANSI E1.2-2021, EN 17115:2018 and, for fabrication quality, EN 1090.

What is a load-span table?

It shows how much weight a given truss can safely carry over a given span, for loads spread evenly or hung at one or more points, and the deflection limit the figures assume.

Box truss, triangle truss or goal-post truss: which do I need?

Box (square) truss suits long spans and heavier lighting and sound loads. Triangle truss is lighter and suits smaller rigs. Goal-post truss is two towers with a crossbeam, used for banners, LED screens and line-array speakers at small and mid-sized events.

How do I check that a truss manufacturer is genuine?

Check the GST number on the GST portal, visit or video-call the factory, ask for certificates in the company's own name, and compare the address and phone numbers across its pages.

Can I import truss instead?

Yes. European and Chinese brands are widely sold in India. Compare landed cost, connector compatibility with your existing stock, and after-sales support with what local makers quote.
